upstream.title: Maintainer clarification: blocking telemetry requests is supported

license.summary: Tasks Vision package is Apache-2.0. Model assets remain external; retain each official distribution notice.

tools.acquisition: Run scripts/setup-tracking.py into a local ignored directory, then prepare-preview.py --tracking-dir. Exact external files, versions, source URLs, sizes and hashes are in tools/tracking-dependencies.json.
tools.notes: Actual physical video input is explicitly opt-in, with no recording or microphone request. Inference is local, but upstream 1.0.1 sends performance/usage telemetry and provides no opt-out API; the kit's server enforces CSP connect-src 'self' to block external sends, including close-time flushes. Other hosting must preserve equivalent CSP and verify blocked attempts separately from transmitted requests. Upstream bytes stay unchanged. Mocopi-style names do not imply a connected device; single-camera body estimates have no independent arm/finger rig.
